description: Retrospective application for the erection of front porch; part single storey side extension; and changes to the windows to suit internal re-modelling of the hall
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (74-76HIBERNIA/FP1, 74-76HIBERNIA/FP3 & Unnumbered Location Plan, received on 31/07/2020; 74-76HIBERNIA/FP2, received on 10/08/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - The windows shown within the north and south elevation of building in the 'toilet and ablution area' shall be fitted with obscure and fixed glazing and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured and fixed glazing.
